title: Matthew McConaughey Says Acting in ‘The Wedding Planner’ With Jennifer Lopez Saved Him From Being Searched at U.S.-Mexico Border: ‘They Let Me Go’
content:
ByZack Sharf

Digital News Director

Matthew McConaugheyrevealed on the “Happy Sad Confused” podcast that acting alongsideJennifer Lopezin 2001’s “The Wedding Planner” ended up getting him out of a “major mess-up” at the U.S.-Mexico border.

“I pull in one late night crossing the border going way down south,” the actor recalled. “I get pulled over, and it’s one of those pull overs. They noticed me and I’m the gringo in the truck. I’m like, ‘Oh jeez. Get the wallet out. Here we go.’ It was going down and then I brought up, ‘Do you guys know Jennifer Lopez? Ever see ‘The Wedding Planner’? Yeah, that was me.’ They all went off… we ended up taking pictures together and they let me go.”

“The Wedding Planner” marked the first rom-com success off McConaughey’s career with $94 million at the global box office. He went on to become a titan of the genre in the 2000s with hits like “How to Lose a Guy in 10 Days,” “Failure To Launch,” “Fool’s Gold” and “Ghosts of Girlfriends Past” all surpassing or coming close to the $100 million mark. McConaughey said on the podcast that “How to Lose a Guy” was the peak of his rom-com tenure.

“I think it’s, probably, my favorite rom-com I’ve done and a lot of people love that rom-com,” the Oscar winner said. “And it still pays the best mailbox money of any film I’ve ever done. By far. By lengths.”

“When it used to be just DVDs or cable, every March I’d get a big check because Valentine’s Day,” McConaughey added. “But, I mean, look: the movie for me, for that genre, let me just own that genre. ‘How to Lose a Guy in 10 Days’ is real anchor in the in the rom-com genre through time.”

McConaughey revealed on the“Good Trouble” podcastin 2024 that he abandoned Hollywood and moved his family to Texas when the industry refused to let him branch out of the rom-com genre. The actor made a conscious decision at the time to stop acting in rom-coms and to take a break from Hollywood until he started getting more dramatic roles.

“When I was rolling with the rom-coms, and I was the ‘rom-com dude,’ that was my lane and I liked that lane. That lane paid well, and it was working,” McConaughey said at the time. “I was so strong in that lane that anything outside that lane – dramas and stuff that I want[ed] to do – were like, ‘No, no, no. No, McConaughey.’ Hollywood said, ’No, no, no. You should stay there.’ So, since I couldn’t do what I wanted to do, I stopped doing what I was doing, and I moved down to the ranch in Texas.”

McConaughey said inan Interview magazine discussionaround the same time that “it was scary” to leave Hollywood while his career was so successful. He even infamously turned down a $14.5 million offer to make another rom-com. Fortunately, Hollywood ended up listening and offers for roles in movies such as “Mud,” “Dallas Buyers Club,” “Interstellar” and “True Detective” ultimately came in and altered the course of his career. McConaughey won the best actor Oscar for “Dallas Buyers Club.”

Watch McConaughey’s full interview on the “Happy Sad Confused” podcast.
title_zh: 馬修·麥康納(Matthew McConaughey)表示，與珍妮佛·洛佩茲(Jennifer Lopez)在《婚禮策劃師》(The Wedding Planner)中演出，讓他免於在美國-墨西哥邊境被搜查：「他們讓我通過。」
content_zh:
扎克·沙夫(Zack Sharf)

數位新聞總監

馬修·麥康納(Matthew McConaughey)在《快樂悲傷困惑(Happy Sad Confused)》播客中透露，與珍妮佛·洛佩茲(Jennifer Lopez)在2001年的電影《婚禮策劃師(The Wedding Planner)》中合作演出，讓他在美墨邊境擺脫了一次「重大失誤」。

「有一個深夜，我開車過邊境，往南走得很遠，」這位演員回憶道。「我被攔下了，這是一種被攔下的情況。他們注意到了我，我是卡車裡的外國人。我心想，‘哦，天啊。拿出錢包。來吧。’事情變得緊張，然後我提到，‘你們知道珍妮佛·洛佩茲嗎？看過《婚禮策劃師》嗎？對，就是我。’他們都驚訝了……我們最終一起拍了照片，他們讓我走了。」

《婚禮策劃師》是麥康納職業生涯中第一部成功的浪漫喜劇，全球票房達到9400萬美元。他在2000年代成為這一類型的巨頭，像《如何在十天內失去一個男人(How to Lose a Guy in 10 Days)》、《失敗的啟航(Failure To Launch)》、《傻瓜的黃金(Fool’s Gold)》和《前女友的幽靈(Ghosts of Girlfriends Past)》等多部影片都超過或接近1億美元的票房。麥康納在播客中表示，《如何在十天內失去一個男人》是他浪漫喜劇生涯的巔峰。

「我想這可能是我做過的最喜歡的浪漫喜劇，很多人都喜歡這部浪漫喜劇，」這位奧斯卡獲獎者說。「而且，它仍然是我做過的任何電影中，帶來的郵箱收入最高的。毫無疑問，遠遠超過其他。」

「當時只要是DVD或有線電視，每年三月我都會因為情人節而收到一張大支票，」麥康納補充道。「但是，看看：對我來說，這部電影，對於這個類型，讓我真正擁有了這個類型。《如何在十天內失去一個男人》在浪漫喜劇類型中是個真正的支柱。」

麥康納在2024年的《好麻煩(Good Trouble)》播客中透露，當好萊塢拒絕讓他拓展浪漫喜劇以外的類型時，他放棄了好萊塢，並將家人搬到了德克薩斯州。當時，這位演員做出了停止參演浪漫喜劇的明智決定，並暫時離開好萊塢，直到他開始獲得更多戲劇性的角色。

「當我在浪漫喜劇中如魚得水，我是那個‘浪漫喜劇男孩’，那是我的領域，我喜歡那個領域。那個領域的收入很好，而且運行得很順利，」麥康納當時說。「我在那個領域如此強大，以至於任何超出那個領域的東西——戲劇和我想做的事情——都被拒絕了，‘不，不，不。麥康納，’好萊塢說，‘不，不，不。你應該留在那裡。’所以，因為我無法做我想做的事情，我停止了我正在做的事情，然後搬到了德克薩斯州的牧場。」

麥康納在同一時期的《訪談(Interview)》雜誌討論中表示，當他的職業生涯如此成功時，離開好萊塢是「可怕的」。他甚至拒絕了一個1450萬美元的報價來拍攝另一部浪漫喜劇。幸運的是，好萊塢最終聽到了他的聲音，像《泥(Mud)》、《達拉斯買家俱樂部(Dallas Buyers Club)》、《星際穿越(Interstellar)》和《真探(True Detective)》等電影的角色邀約最終出現，改變了他的職業生涯。麥康納因《達拉斯買家俱樂部》獲得了最佳男主角奧斯卡獎。

觀看馬修·麥康納(Matthew McConaughey)在《快樂悲傷混亂》(Happy Sad Confused) 播客上的完整訪談。
